projects.title: A collaborative document-annotation system based on reStructuredText
projects.summary: Extend reStructuredText to support inline annotations and discussions that remain robust to document changes, with a single source of truth for the document.

projects.title: A deduplicating file system based on content-aware chunking
projects.summary: Design a deduplicating file system that splits files into chunks using a content-based hash rather than fixed-size blocks, so that insertions do not destroy deduplication. A follow-up asks how to normalize binaries (e.g. jump targets) in a live file system to improve deduplication.

projects.title: A different kind of performance profiler
projects.summary: Design a profiler that uses memory snapshots and taint tracking to flag redundant or unused computations, reporting how many distinct results each function computes and whether results are used, to guide memoization and removal of wasted work.

projects.title: A proof-friendly representation of hardware circuits
projects.summary: Design or identify a circuit representation suitable for use as a compilation target in Rocq that is easy to reason about and supports sharing and optimizations, and use it to retarget the Kôika compiler and reduce its trusted base.

projects.title: Abusing the instruction cache to store data
projects.summary: Encode constant data in the instruction cache through dynamically generated code, so that programs such as SMT solvers can free data-cache pressure. The example replaces a loop adding a constant vector with unrolled code that embeds the constants as immediates.

projects.title: Add post-macro-expansion mode to latexdiff
projects.summary: Patch latexdiff to expand simple custom LaTeX macros before running its diff algorithm, so that diffs show the expanded content rather than macro invocations.

projects.title: Alectryon ports to new proof languages
projects.summary: Extend Alectryon to support additional proof languages and protocols, such as F*, HOL-light, or other systems beyond the already supported Rocq and Lean, to compare how communities present their proofs.

projects.title: An Alectryon backend for coqdoc
projects.summary: Write a coqdoc backend that generates Alectryon documents, making it easier to switch between the two documentation tools for Rocq.

projects.title: Better unification in Rocq
projects.summary: Make Rocq's unification report failures more eagerly by pinpointing where a naive unification attempt fails, instead of reporting that a whole goal fails to unify with a lemma.

projects.title: Code-size optimizations for keyboard macros
projects.summary: Design and implement an optimizer that suggests shorter or more ergonomic key combinations for keyboard macros as users type, for example in Emacs or vim. Follow-ups cover physical hand models and aggregated telemetry.

projects.title: Compressed datastructures and application-specific RAM compression
projects.summary: Investigate application-specific compression schemes that are compatible with the operations performed on the decompressed data, keeping existing data structures and applying compression to slices of program data. The example given is compressing the two sides of an Emacs gap buffer separately.

projects.title: Cross-language editing and debugging for legacy code
projects.summary: Write a readable translator from a legacy language such as COBOL into Python, and a reverse translator that back-propagates changes made to the translation to the source. A follow-up proposes back-propagating manual optimizations from assembly to C.

projects.title: Deriving tools from annotated grammars
projects.summary: Enhance a parser generator such as Menhir to accept indentation and other annotations, so that one grammar drives syntax highlighting, indentation, structural editing and folding in editors, with error recovery for partial programs. A follow-up covers grammar-based completion and bounded lookback.

projects.title: Does semantic versioning work?
projects.summary: Study whether human-assigned version numbers follow semantic versioning, using API diffs and downstream test-suite breakage to check consistency, and compare with tools such as semantic-release and automatic enforcement.

projects.title: Early reclamation for lazy values in Scala
projects.summary: Change the JVM backend of the Scala compiler to null out stack variables right after their last use, so that lazy lists consumed by a function such as foreach can be garbage-collected while being processed.

projects.title: Fixing reStructuredText
projects.summary: Design and implement a conservative extension of reStructuredText that supports nesting of inline constructs and offers an alternative to heavy indentation for long blocks of text.

projects.title: Fused decompression and decoding
projects.summary: Explore fusing decompression with decoding (e.g. gzip+JSON) so that redundant data in the compressed stream is decoded once instead of once per repetition.

projects.title: Hierarchical rendering of separation-logic formulae
projects.summary: Extend the SepViz system into a hierarchical renderer that nests diagrams and formulae, so that it can display nested predicates such as specifications of higher-order functions, non-prenex quantification, and complex predicates inside iterated separating conjunctions.

projects.title: Hindley-Milner for Rocq
projects.summary: Extend Rocq's type inference so that it introduces new type variables for remaining holes, enabling simple non-dependently typed definitions such as a generic map function, and study how this approach fails and what errors it produces.

projects.title: Mixed rendering for proof presentation
projects.summary: Design a modular constraint-solving based renderer that can mix graphs, pretty-printing, mathematical notation and other visual formats in proof assistant goals, with a notation mechanism in Rocq and a focus on continuity between consecutive proof states.

projects.title: PCP encoding for Rocq's VM
projects.summary: Investigate a probabilistically checkable proof (PCP) encoding of traces of Rocq's virtual machine, so that a claimed reduction can be verified cheaply.

projects.title: Printing with sharing in Rocq
projects.summary: Add an option, similar to Lisp's *print-circle*, that prints Rocq terms with sharing so that term sizes and memory usage can be analysed more easily when debugging performance issues.

projects.title: Profiling automated verifiers
projects.summary: Build a profiler that attributes SMT solving time to the tasks of the verifier stack (symbolic executor, verifier, solver) and identifies redundant work such as useless quantifier instantiations, evaluated on real verifier performance issues.

projects.title: Reducing common sources of branch target aliasing
projects.summary: Explore software and hardware approaches to reduce branch-predictor aliasing caused by common code patterns in lazy-language runtimes and bytecode interpreters, for example by assigning distinct branches to each lazy value or exposing the interpreted program counter to the hardware.

projects.title: Single-step eauto for Rocq
projects.summary: Implement an eauto_one tactic that applies any lemma from a given hint database matching the current goal, replacing an existing complicated trick for extensible forward reasoning.

projects.title: Static-checking RPG quests
projects.summary: Use automated program verification to prove functional and reachability/liveness properties of role-playing game quests written in modder scripting languages, to detect quests that get stuck, can be completed twice, or lack a reward path.

projects.title: The user experience of mechanized diagram-chasing proofs
projects.summary: Build lightweight mockups of scripted interactions to explore how diagram-chasing proofs should be visualized and manipulated in a proof assistant, including layout, incremental re-layout, and the representation of diagrams.

projects.title: What performance do compiler updates buy you?
projects.summary: Compile selected historical programs with successive versions of a compiler such as GCC to measure the runtime speedup gained and the increase in compilation time, with a follow-up on which optimizations speed up compiling the compiler itself.

projects.title: In-context learning as approximated Bayesian inference
projects.summary: Examines whether the in-context learning ability of transformers can be explained as implicit gradient descent, as the 'ICL as GD' hypothesis proposes. The project aims to show that for more complex statistical problems and architectures, transformers learn more sophisticated mechanisms, such as approximated Bayesian inference.

projects.title: Characterizing Neuronal Activity in Brain Organoids Across Neurodevelopmental Disorder Mutants
projects.summary: Analyzes existing multielectrode array (MEA) recordings from brain organoids carrying neurodevelopmental disorder-associated mutations and healthy controls, quantifying network activity features such as firing rates, bursts and synchrony. The student then trains interpretable machine learning classifiers to distinguish mutant from wildtype organoids, with an optional extension on developmental timepoints.

projects.title: Learning trajectories in models and children
projects.summary: Treats language model training as a developmental trajectory and asks whether the order and timing of language abilities emerging in artificial systems match those of children. The work combines training densely checkpointed models from scratch (with learned tokenizers, joint text-vision-audio learning, and constrained initializations) with structural probing, in collaboration with developmental neuroscientists and psycholinguists.

projects.title: 729 – Robotic paleontology: tail strike defense
projects.summary: Design, build and control a life-sized robotic tail to replicate a dinosaur's club-tail strike, and measure impact force and velocity using fossil-based bone-like material at Empa Dübendorf. The thesis combines mechanical design, microcontroller programming, force measurements and data analysis.

projects.title: 734 – Firmware development for ENVIROBOT
projects.summary: Continue the development of ENVIROBOT by adapting the existing firmware to a new electronic board and extending it with new functionality. The work is mainly software on an embedded microcontroller platform.

projects.title: 782 – Radio communication module on 169.4 MHz
projects.summary: Finalize a prototype bidirectional serial link based on a CC1120 radio chip at 169.4 MHz, by redesigning the PCBs, improving communication software and stability, adding a simple user interface on the microcontroller, and adding flow control on the robot side.

projects.title: 783 – Paleorobotics of Armored Tail Strikes: Simulation, Compliance, and Energy Dissipation in Extinct Mammalian Weapons
projects.summary: Use paleorobotics to test whether extinct armored mammals could generate powerful tail-club strikes, by building MuJoCo and SIMM/OpenSim-type models of a tendon-driven tail and mapping strike energy dissipation. Optional work includes a biomimetic carapace and a tendon-driven tail prototype, split between EPFL and University of Zurich.

projects.title: 784 – Modeling zebrafish sensorimotor integration using simulation and robots
projects.summary: Model zebrafish sensorimotor integration using neuromechanical simulation and the ZBot fish-like robot, in an ongoing collaboration with Duke University. Possible avenues include improving the FARMS simulation framework, applying deep reinforcement learning to sensory-motor circuits, and studying visually-guided behaviors.

projects.title: 785 – (New!) Mobile Manipulation of Assistive Robotic Furniture
projects.summary: Integrate a robot arm with a mobile robotic furniture platform and develop a whole-body controller so that a mobile table can fetch objects for a wheelchair user, e.g. bringing a cup of water. The goal is an end-to-end demonstration in MuJoCo simulation and in the real world.

projects.title: 786 – (New!) User-Centric Multimodal Interaction for Assistive Robotic Environments
projects.summary: Study the everyday challenges of wheelchair users and investigate how multiple user interfaces (markerless body-language tracking, LLM/VLM natural-language control, tablet) can give accessible control of mobile robotic furniture. The student can further develop or evaluate one interaction modality.

projects.title: 789 – Spine motion replication
projects.summary: Replicate the spine motion of quadruped locomotion with fewer actuators than a fully articulated spine would need, reducing weight and mechanical complexity. The project is 100% software.

projects.title: Acquisition-Application co-optimization of a Level-Crossing ADC for Implantable Neural Interfaces
projects.summary: Master project on co-optimizing the acquisition and application of a level-crossing ADC for implantable neural interfaces.

projects.title: Application Deployment and Software Optimization on a Near-Memory Computing Platform for Edge AI and Multimedia
projects.summary: Semester project on deploying applications and optimizing software on a near-memory computing platform for edge AI and multimedia.

projects.title: Architecture Definition and FPGA Deployment of a Near-Memory Computing Platform for Edge AI and Multimedia
projects.summary: Semester project defining the architecture and deploying on FPGA a near-memory computing platform for edge AI and multimedia.

projects.title: Automatic geolocation of acoustic events using the VersaSens platform
projects.summary: Semester project on automatically geolocating acoustic events using the VersaSens platform.

projects.title: Automation of a semi-custom design and verification flow for ultra-low-leakage always-on circuits relying on differential logic
projects.summary: Master student assistant project (remunerated) on automating a semi-custom design and verification flow for ultra-low-leakage always-on circuits based on differential logic.

projects.title: Characterisation and Integration of a Modular Optical Physiological Sensing Module into VersaSens
projects.summary: Master project to characterise a modular optical physiological sensing module and integrate it into the VersaSens platform.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Time-Series Embedding Methods for Seizure Classification
projects.summary: Semester project comparing time-series embedding methods for seizure classification.

projects.summary: Master or semester project on custom hardware design of posit arithmetic operators for low-precision computing.

projects.title: Deployment of an unsupervised deep adaptive filtering method for context-aware and robust Heart Rate extraction in constrained wearables
projects.summary: Semester project on deploying an unsupervised deep adaptive filtering method for robust heart rate extraction on constrained wearables.

projects.title: Deployment of probabilistic deep learning methods for context-aware and robust Heart Rate extraction in constrained wearables
projects.summary: Semester project on deploying probabilistic deep learning methods for robust heart rate extraction on resource-constrained wearables.

projects.title: Design of a Multiple-Issue Execution Pipeline for an Out-Of-Order RISC-V Processor
projects.summary: Master project to design a multiple-issue execution pipeline for an out-of-order RISC-V processor.

projects.title: Design of efficient Convolutional Layers for Near-Memory Computing IPs based on RISC-V
projects.summary: Semester project on designing efficient convolutional layers for near-memory computing IPs based on RISC-V.

projects.title: Development of a patch-sized PCB for long-term skin conductance monitoring using HEEPidermis
projects.summary: Master student assistant project (remunerated) to develop a patch-sized PCB for long-term skin conductance monitoring using HEEPidermis.

projects.title: Development of a TFT display interface for VersaSens
projects.summary: Semester project on developing a TFT display interface for the VersaSens platform.

projects.title: Enabling Local Tightly, Global Loosely coupled Programmable Accelerators Heterogeneous Systems by integrating X-HEEP into ESP SoCs
projects.summary: Master project on integrating X-HEEP into ESP SoCs to enable heterogeneous systems with locally tightly and globally loosely coupled programmable accelerators.

projects.title: Enhancing the Efficiency and Accuracy of Radio Interferometry Kernels using CGRA-ME Framework
projects.summary: Master or semester project on improving efficiency and accuracy of radio interferometry kernels using the CGRA-ME framework.

projects.title: Evaluating the Energy Efficiency of Arithmetic Formats in Edge AI Wearable Deployment
projects.summary: Master project evaluating the energy efficiency of arithmetic number formats when deploying edge AI on wearables.

projects.title: Extraction of Heart-Related Information in Epileptic Patients
projects.summary: Semester project on extracting heart-related information from epileptic patients' physiological data.

projects.title: Eyes on the Unmeasured: Blind Forecasting through Multivariate Attention Networks
projects.summary: Master project on blind forecasting of unmeasured variables using multivariate attention networks.

projects.title: Fast compilation for Coarse-Grained Reconfigurable Arrays (CGRAs) via Graph Minors
projects.summary: Master project on fast compilation for CGRAs using graph minor techniques.

projects.title: FPGA implementation and validation of a Compute-Memory architecture for DNN inference applications
projects.summary: Semester project on implementing and validating a compute-memory architecture for DNN inference on FPGA.

projects.title: From Telemetry to Flexibility Services: Schema Design for Data Centres as Energy Prosumers
projects.summary: Master project on designing data schemas that let data centres act as energy prosumers offering flexibility services based on telemetry.

projects.title: Implementation of an Accelerator based on Near-Memory Computing IPs for a RISC-V-based Microcontroller
projects.summary: Master project implementing an accelerator based on near-memory computing IPs for a RISC-V microcontroller.

projects.title: Implementation of automation techniques for IMC arrays
projects.summary: Semester project on implementing automation techniques for in-memory computing (IMC) arrays.

projects.title: Integration and optimization of Ultra Low Power CPU on the X-HEEP platform targeting implantable devices
projects.summary: Master or semester project on integrating and optimizing an ultra-low-power CPU on the X-HEEP platform for implantable devices.

projects.title: Microarchitectural explorations for biomedical applications
projects.summary: Explore whether an in-order superscalar RISC-V core (CV32E20) instead of the current single-issue core in X-HEEP can improve energy efficiency for the BiomedBench biomedical wearable applications. The student will build a lightweight RISC-V simulator, generate execution traces, model superscalar execution, and later assess power overheads.

projects.title: Mind the Gaps: Missing-Aware Embedding Layers for Transformer Forecasting
projects.summary: Semester project on missing-aware embedding layers for transformer-based time series forecasting.

projects.title: ML-based Design Space Exploration Framework for LLM Inference in Mixed-Precision Systolic Arrays
projects.summary: Semester project on a machine-learning-based design space exploration framework for LLM inference on mixed-precision systolic arrays.

projects.title: Multi-CGRA Tile Accelerator: Integration, Modeling, and Scalability Analysis
projects.summary: Master project on integration, modeling and scalability analysis of a multi-CGRA tile accelerator.

projects.title: Optimization of Transformer-based ensemble
projects.summary: Semester project on optimizing a transformer-based ensemble model.

projects.title: Physiological Data Collection Platform for WearOS Smartwatches
projects.summary: Semester project on building a platform to collect physiological data from WearOS smartwatches.

projects.title: Porting X-HEEP to a Lattice FPGA with open-source EDA tools
projects.summary: Semester project on porting the X-HEEP platform to a Lattice FPGA using open-source EDA tools.

projects.title: Precision-Scalable Systolic Arrays for High-Efficiency LLM Inference Acceleration
projects.summary: Project on precision-scalable systolic arrays to accelerate LLM inference efficiently.

projects.title: Scalable Memory-Mapped Systolic Array Cluster for LLM Inference
projects.summary: Semester project on a scalable memory-mapped cluster of systolic arrays for LLM inference.

projects.title: Streaming Wake-Up Networks for Low-Power Sensor Processing
projects.summary: Master student assistant project (remunerated) on streaming wake-up networks for low-power sensor processing, as stated by the title.

projects.title: Testing and verification of a fabricated IMC memory
projects.summary: Semester project on testing and verifying a fabricated in-memory computing (IMC) memory chip.

projects.title: Towards Audio-Visual Speech Separation and Recognition
projects.summary: Semester project towards audio-visual speech separation and recognition.

projects.title: Towards intelligent laser welding: automatic control of processing quality using reinforcement learning and deep neural architectures
projects.summary: Master project on automatically controlling laser welding quality using reinforcement learning and deep neural architectures.

projects.title: Visual X-HEEP: Enhancing X-HEEP with Camera Interfaces and VGA monitors
projects.summary: Semester project adding camera interfaces and VGA monitor support to the X-HEEP platform.

projects.title: When Sensors Go Silent: Masked Multivariate Transformers for Robust Urban Water Forecasting
projects.summary: Master project on robust urban water forecasting with masked multivariate transformers when sensors fail.

projects.title: X-HEEP Accelerators: design, verification, and integration of a general purpose co-processor/accelerator based on RISC-V for edge-computing SoCs
projects.summary: Master project on designing, verifying and integrating a general-purpose RISC-V co-processor/accelerator for edge-computing SoCs.

projects.title: Accurate movement trajectory decoding for high-performance brain-machine interfaces
projects.summary: Build a regressor that decodes continuous movement trajectories (hand and finger positions) from ECoG and/or spiking activity in patients. Students will study neural biomarkers and implement feature-engineered and end-to-end machine learning models.

projects.title: Circuit Design and Verification for a Low-Power Neural Network Accelerator for Neural Decoding
projects.summary: Design and verify low-power, near-threshold circuits, including a level shifter and SRAM, for a neural network accelerator used in neuromodulation systems. Students will review literature, define specifications with PhD researchers, and evaluate a fabricated integrated circuit.

projects.title: Circuit design for stimulation artifact cancellation in concurrent neural recording and stimulation
projects.summary: Design artifact cancellation circuits in Cadence to remove large stimulation artifacts from low-amplitude neural recordings during concurrent recording and stimulation. Students will explore algorithms and hardware architectures, assess complexity, and help design and test prototype integrated circuits.

projects.title: Detecting mental fatigue and symptoms of psychiatric disorders from continuous neuronal recordings
projects.summary: Explore machine learning tools to detect the onset of mental fatigue and neuropsychiatric symptoms from multi-channel ECoG and LFP recordings in primates (and possibly humans). Students will study biomarkers and optimize classifiers for accuracy and latency.

projects.title: Exploring Mimed and Covert Speech Decoding from EEG
projects.summary: Design and validate an EEG experiment for mimed and covert speech, collect a dataset, and assess the feasibility of decoding a small vocabulary. The project also studies which electrode locations and reduced channel configurations are most informative for speech decoding. It is designed for two students, each responsible for one speech condition.

projects.title: Exploring Representation Learning for Neural Signal Decoders
projects.summary: Improve representation learning for neural signal decoders, such as vector-quantization on transformer-based neural foundation models or self-supervised methods, to decode ECoG signals from movement attempts for a Brain Spine Interface. Detailed objectives are flexible and can be discussed.

projects.title: Machine learning chip design for on-implant neural decoding
projects.summary: Design an efficient feature extraction and/or machine learning processor that classifies or decodes neural data in real time on implants, with low power and small area. Students will design candidate algorithms in Cadence and assess hardware complexity with simulations, then help test prototype integrated circuits.

projects.title: Patient-Independent Seizure Detection from Intracranial EEG
projects.summary: Develop deep learning methods for seizure detection from intracranial EEG that generalize across patients. Students will evaluate models on public datasets and study how learned neural representations improve robustness and cross-subject generalization.

projects.title: Resource-efficient machine learning algorithm design for on-implant neurological symptom detection
projects.summary: Develop efficient machine learning models that process electrophysiological data (scalp EEG, ECoG, spikes) in real time with low power, small on-chip area and fast inference for neurological symptom detection on implants. Students will implement models, evaluate them, and estimate hardware complexity.

projects.title: Speech Decoding for Brain-Computer Interfaces
projects.summary: Develop and evaluate deep learning models that decode speech from neural activity for speech BCIs. The project explores strategies to improve generalization across sessions or conditions and analyzes learned neural representations.
